title: From the Start
lyrics:
[00:04.73]Don't you notice how
[00:07.77]I get quiet when there's no one else around?
[00:12.95]Me and you and awkward silence
[00:15.69]Don't you dare look at me that way
[00:20.68]I don't need reminders of how you don't feel the same
[00:25.33]Oh, the burning pain
[00:28.57]Listening to you harp on 'bout some new soulmate
[00:33.55]"She's so perfect," blah, blah, blah
[00:35.99]Oh, how I wish you'd wake up one day
[00:41.33]Run to me, confess your love, at least just let me say
[00:46.25]That when I talk to you
[00:48.91]Oh, Cupid walks right through
[00:51.48]And shoots an arrow through my heart
[00:56.65]And I sound like a loon
[00:59.22]But don't you feel it, too?
[01:01.78]Confess I loved you from the start
[01:27.20]What's a girl to do?
[01:30.43]Lying on my bed staring into the blue
[01:35.50]Unrequited, terrifying
[01:38.23]Love is driving me a bit insane
[01:43.28]Have to get this off my chest, I'm telling you today
[01:48.28]That when I talk to you
[01:50.82]Oh, Cupid walks right through
[01:53.40]And shoots an arrow through my heart
[01:58.60]And I sound like a loon
[02:01.16]But don't you feel it, too?
[02:03.72]Confess I loved you from the start
[02:09.13]Confess I loved you
[02:12.46]Just thinking of you
[02:17.05]You know I've loved you from the start
